question: Should experimental Claw packages standardize on `CLAW.md` as the canonical export artifact, while continuing to accept grouped JSON input?
rationale: This is a new public experimental package-format and export-default direction, not a repair to an established main-branch contract; source review cannot choose the permanent authoring and interoperability policy.

options.title: Sponsor the CLAW.md format
options.body: Confirm `CLAW.md` as the canonical experimental export after the prerequisite lifecycle stack lands, contingent on current-head round-trip proof and explicit JSON-compatibility coverage.

options.title: Keep JSON canonical
options.body: Retain grouped JSON as the export artifact and defer or close the Markdown-format adapter until a maintainer-approved package-format decision exists.

options.title: Narrow the experiment
options.body: Accept `CLAW.md` only as an input adapter while preserving JSON export until interoperability and migration expectations are decided.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the CLAW.md format
recommendation.body: Confirm `CLAW.md` as the canonical experimental export after the prerequisite lifecycle stack lands, contingent on current-head round-trip proof and explicit JSON-compatibility coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the identified contributor across the current and prior CLAW.md slices and can route the stack context to the appropriate repository decision-makers.
